Features:

ESP - like player highlighting through walls, etc.

Tracers – added tracers that track and show where players are looking. Full customization of tracers.

Move In Air – allows you to move freely in the air while jumping.

AutoSpin – AutoSpin works. You can choose which slot to spin and the spin type. Both Style Spin and Ability Spin work.

Hitbox Expander Ball - Changes the ball's hitbox; you can make it colossally large, and it will work.

Hitbox Settings - simple hitbox adjustments: change its size, color, and transparency.

Config System - one of the most complex parts of this script. Basically, it remembers the functions you want to include in the config. First, you run the functions, then type the config name, and then click Create Config. This config can be deleted, set to auto-run, or removed from auto-run.
